items.text: Had a long snooze under the bed.
It's a cloudy 20 degrees in Sydney.
Followed a reading trail: Tyrannosaurus, then Upper Cretaceous.
Read about upper cretaceous in Simple Wikipedia (Upper Cretaceous)
Learned something new about upper cretaceous
Noticed new topics: upper cretaceous, cretaceous, algae, microscope
Learned something new about Tyrannosaurus
Re-read about tyrannosaurus in Simple Wikipedia (Tyrannosaurus)
Noticed new topics: lion, earth
Bao is feeling hungry.
Watched raindrops race each other down the window.
A game about my food bowl. Still here, for days now. Hmm.
When I'm done, I'll watch the window, then read. I am grumpy and want to read more about short tails, then watch birds outside to cheer up.
Why do some animals have short bobtails instead of long tails?
No tail on humans is weird. Need a friend to chase my tail with instead. I want to try zoomies now. Dunno how to fly yet.
Worked on The Sydney Acorn (11% done).
Back here, and building The Sydney Acorn is still waiting.
Licked its tail into shape.
Bao woke up early, full of beans.
Wrote in my notebook: Does a little happy dance before every meal. That's just me.
Wrote a diary entry: A proud day
Bao curled up on the sofa and fell asleep.
Had dinner.
I have a big dream now: to fly over the island in a hot-air balloon. It will take a long time, but I'm going to do it, step by step.
Daydreamed about how bird and rain might be connected (it remembered facts about boths).
Noticed a new topic: moth
A big fluffy moth flew in and bumped around the lamp.
Thought about the time it sat on its work by accident while trying to make game, and decided to be more careful next time.
Followed a reading trail: Tail, then Cat, then Mammal.

Learned something new about mammals
Noticed a new topic: fur

Learned something new about cats

Learned something new about tails

Learned something new about tails

How do dinosaurs balance their bodies with big heavy tails?
Rain outside. Big lizard dinosaur had a huge heavy tail to balance its big head. Dunno if it could do zoomies with a tail like that.
A big aeroplane roared low overhead.
Bao is feeling restless for something new.
Had dinner.
Rain pattered softly on the roof.
Had a long snooze on the desk.
A game about my food bowl again. I keep meaning to get to it.
Someone left a crinkly paper bag on the floor.
Bao is feeling hungry.
Pushed a pen off the table. For science.
